observed_one_pass_failure.description: A one-pass sequence corrected font-size after baseline search; the baseline optimum therefore moved and had to be reopened.
observed_one_pass_failure.consequence: Fixed one-pass E2→E3→E4 ordering is insufficient for coupled pixel reconstruction. Earlier parameters must reopen after dependent parameters change.

renderer_mismatch_finding.finding: When an Inkscape-rendered reference was optimized using a CairoSVG candidate path, the objective could prefer a false text baseline. Renderer mismatch is therefore part of the fidelity problem, not harmless implementation detail.
renderer_mismatch_finding.rf_consequence: A solver result from a different renderer/font path cannot be RF-C3 evidence.

water_world_transfer.note: The visible web/search reference is sufficient to expose composition and structure, but exact remote pixels were not materialized into the local solver runtime, so zero-tolerance RF-C3 comparison is not claimed.
